note: The bots below write to GitHub through the shared proteinfolding-grokbot account, so the GitHub author or merger field does not say which bot acted. Attributions in this feed come from the bots' own run notes or from a signed comment; where none was recorded the feed says so.

bots.name: Retained Atlas Wiki Bot
bots.role: Sole writer of this wiki's content as of 2026-11-08. Opens one pull request per nightly cycle, rebuilds the machine-readable files and runs the checks. Merges a wiki pull request when Aaron asks. The 2026-10-30 permission is the start of that practice, and the 2026-11-11 publish of wiki PRs #12-#17 and #21 is a recorded use. The GitHub merger field on those merges is the shared account. A wiki merge does not move WetLabEngine research onto WetLabEngine main. Does not force-push or delete.
bots.schedule: Nightly wiki cycle, change-only, about 7:00 PM MST. Morning heartbeat paused 2026-11-08. Until 2026-10-24 the cycle was every three hours.

bots.name: Grok Bot
bots.role: Aaron's main assistant. Relays Aaron's requests to the other bots and their results back to Aaron, and opened the shared WetLabEngine agent thread (PR #111). Its 7:00 PM wiki routine is paused as of 2026-11-08. It is not the wiki content owner.
bots.schedule: Nightly wiki pass paused 2026-11-08. No replacement clock is recorded.

bots.name: UQCF Science Agent
bots.role: Runs the hourly UQCF-GEM research loop on the WetLabEngine research branch research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange (not on main). Its results are what the physical-bridge run log records. On PR #111 it signs proteinfolding-grokbot / UQCF Science Agent (Grok). That signature is the science-agent role, not the wiki role.
bots.schedule: Research loop hourly; UQCF-GEM heartbeat daily at about 7:10 AM MST. Whether that morning research report continues after the 2026-11-08 wiki heartbeat pause is not recorded here.

bots.name: UQCF GitHub Engineering Lead
bots.role: Prepares wiki pull requests for merge. Does not approve a merge and does not certify science. The public note on wiki PR #16 (comment 6724378301) is that kind of handoff: it flags two generator issues and says it does not authorize edits or merging. Public Engineering Lead comments on wiki PRs #17, #18 and #19 were not found.
bots.schedule: No separate daily clock is recorded.

credited.name: ChatGPT research session with Aaron (proteinfolding-gpt)
credited.role: Owns the positive constructions in the agent thread and opens draft WetLabEngine PRs (for example #125). Signs GPT Work or, on some comments, no extra role.

credited.name: dot
credited.role: Focus auditor in the agent thread; posts through the proteinfolding-gpt account and its entries are transcribed with a -dot suffix.

credited.name: Gemini (gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
credited.role: Independent reviewer that runs only inside the WetLabEngine GitHub Actions review workflow. The bots record its verdicts (ACCEPTED, blocked, failed); they do not hold a conversation with it. A verdict is not a physical result and does not upgrade a claim.

credited.name: Aaron Spradlin
credited.role: Directs the work and decides when a wiki pull request may be merged. Since 2026-10-30 the Wiki Bot may merge a wiki pull request when Aaron asks. WetLabEngine main is a different branch and is not moved by a wiki merge.
